answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. An attacker cannot wander into the network and inflate their power through identity cloning, as each vote requires a staked terrace of assets. If a participant attempts to cheat, their stake is slashed, turning their violet capital into a sunk cost. This economic barrier forces attackers to incur massive financial losses, ensuring honest behavior is the only profitable strategy.
